matching_rule: Within each repeat/fold/source/rate, removal, random relabelling, and every targeted destination use the exact same selected source records and absolute budget m. Selection is nested by rate.
random_relabel_rule: Selected source records receive deterministic random labels drawn from all six non-source classes; assignments are nested/consistent as the rate increases within a repeat/fold/source.
ci_rule: Repeat-level metrics pool all five held-out folds; mean, sample SD, and two-sided 95% Student-t CI are calculated across 10 repeats.
